entry.title: dotnet/maui - Issues & Pull Requests - 2026-01-29
entry.content:

  • I9-On macOS 26.2, the "Animate scroll" button is white by default on iOS and Maccatalyst platforms. #33767
  • [Testing][Android] Fix flaky tests for CookiesCorrectlyLoadWithMultipleWebViews in CI #33766

  • X-Maui-Request-Body blocked the emoji text. #33758
